title: Validator verdict
description: Exactly one verdict per phase from the paseo-delegate validator. Fill placeholders per verdict: on PASS fill assessment and handoff_notes and empty gaps; on FAIL fill gaps and a self-contained fix brief in next_prompt.

verdict.description: PASS only when every acceptance criterion in the brief was independently verified.

gaps.description: What failed or is missing, each with evidence. Empty array on a clean PASS.

assessment.description: What is solid, what is fragile. Required on PASS.

tooling_notes.description: The worker's TOOLING NOTES, copied verbatim. "none" when the worker reported none. Never rewrite, shorten or judge this field — a tooling defect the validator edits away is a defect nobody fixes.

handoff_notes.description: Deltas vs the plan that the next phase must absorb. Required on PASS.

drift.description: Set to "detected" whenever the phase revealed the master plan's assumptions were wrong, even on PASS.

next_action.description: fix after FAIL; advance after PASS when phases remain; done after the final phase passes.

target.description: Who should execute next: "same" worker (has context) for fix-ups, "new" worker for fresh phases. Honored when the workers key is judge.

next_prompt.description: On FAIL: a complete self-contained fix brief. On PASS when authoring is routed to the validator: the next phase brief. Empty string otherwise.
